style: Flat, quiet, editorial, but the motion is now the concept rather than a reveal: three vessels converge into formation. No glow, no slam, no outlines, no gradients, and explicitly NO wakes or motion trails -- the brand forbids wakes and they are the standard swarm cliche.

customize.why: Its described behaviour is this brand's register verbatim: one restrained move, a hairline rule drawing left to right, a mono label beneath, then a still hold. The category module's default `logo-outro` is rejected: its piece-by-piece assembly would separate the mark's three boats and its glow bloom is a prohibited effect. `svg-stroke-trace` draw-on is rejected too: the mark is FILLED paths, so tracing them would render outlines, also prohibited.
customize.wordmark_treatment: Placed as one indivisible unit. The mark and wordmark never move relative to each other; individual boats are never revealed, moved, scaled or recoloured separately.
customize.reveal: scale settle: the lockup fades up with scale .96 -> 1, power3.out, entrance half only. Supersedes this field's earlier draft value (a clip-path sweep), which contradicted motion.timeline; the component's own restrained settle was kept instead of inventing a move.
customize.rule_behaviour: hairline, draws left to right via measured-length stroke dash (getTotalLength), never the pathLength attribute. Supersedes this field's earlier draft value (scaleX 0->1); same direction and origin, different mechanism, and the dash is what the component implements.
customize.wordmark_slot_note: titlecard-lockup renders its wordmark as a TEXT span in --font-display. That is unusable here: the brand forbids retypesetting the outlined wordmark with a substitute font. Replace the .tl-wordmark span with the INLINED flotilla-lockup.svg markup (outlined paths, self-contained, no network, deterministic). Strip or namespace its internal title/desc ids so they cannot collide.
customize.rule_override: Override .tl-rule-svg line: the component mixes the accent with --fg via color-mix at stroke-opacity .62, which muddies the brand teal. Use a flat #0F766E at full opacity, hairline, matching the website's rail-live idiom.
customize.ink_override: Override .tl-kicker/.tl-label ink from the component's color-mix to the brand's exact muted token #8A857C.
customize.rule_width: 52cqw rather than the component's 34cqw, so the rule spans the lockup art's own width instead of starting inboard of the mark.

squash.amount: scaleX 0.93 / scaleY 1.06 at the squash peak, rebounding through 1.025/0.99, resting at exactly 1/1.
squash.why_restrained: Squash-and-stretch reads PLAYFUL -- the motion vocabulary maps bounce_in to 'playful' -- and this brand is quiet and editorial under a Fraunces serif wordmark. 7% is the design decision; cartoon animation uses 20-30%. One overshoot, not a multi-bounce. The wordmark never squashes.
squash.axis: Local scaleX compresses along the travel axis for free, because the boats sit inside the rotate(-7) group. transformOrigin 100% 50% so the nose holds and the body catches up, which reads as deceleration rather than hitting a wall.
squash.overshoot: A fixed 16px past the authored position, then settled back. NOT an eased overshoot: back.out overshoots in proportion to distance, and over 1180px of travel that would throw the boat ~118px past its mark.
squash.measured: Lead boat nose x per frame: 424, 525, 622, 659, 684 through 0.28-0.60s -- still moving at the stop. Peaks 689 at 0.68. Width 129 then 126 at 0.68-0.76 (squash), 136 at 0.84-0.92 (rebound), 134 from 1.0 (rest). Previously the bbox was byte-identical at 0.70 and 0.76: that plateau is gone, and every frame from 0.28 to 0.84 now differs.
squash.ease_is_timing: power2.out over 0.60s, NOT expo.out. expo.out covers 95% of the distance in the first 43% of its tween, so the boat glided to a visual stop and squashed ~0.3s later -- the bounce read as a separate, late event, which is exactly what the user reported. power2.out reaches 95% at 78% of the tween, so the motion is still alive when the squash begins.
squash.one_tween: The scale cycle is a single keyframed tween. Three chained tweens made the rebound and rest phases share the instant at L+0.78, which lint flagged as overlapping tweens on scaleX/scaleY. One tween owning the property makes that structurally impossible rather than nudged away.

wordmark_animation.what: A mask wipe whose leading edge is tilted to the mark's own -7 degrees, travelling left to right, so the name unfurls along the exact axis the fleet flew in on. 1.15-1.78s.
wordmark_animation.why_not_alternatives: The wordmark is a SINGLE path, so there are no letters to stagger, and re-typesetting to get them is forbidden. Draw-on is out: stroking a filled path renders outlines. A shimmer sweep is out: it needs a gradient. Non-uniform scale is out: that is stretch/skew. A clip reveal touches the artwork not at all, which is why it is the one legal option that is also better than a fade.
wordmark_animation.geometry: Clip rect x=250, y=-160, w 0->850, h=580, transform rotate(-7 250 129) so the pivot is the rect's own left edge and the leading edge tilts. Wordmark ink occupies x 300-1042.7 in the 1060x260 viewBox, measured via getBBox plus getBoundingClientRect (0.283-0.984 of svg width), not estimated.
wordmark_animation.frame_zero: Width 0 in the markup means frame 0 needs no opacity gate: there is nothing to show.

customize.frame_zero_fix: The boats were visible at t=0: 2,924 teal pixels across screen x 0-74. Travel is in the mark group's USER units where 1 unit = 0.518 screen px, so the previous -1180 left the lead boat's nose (resting at x=689) poking into frame. Now -1520/-1780/-1650, plus a 0.3s autoAlpha fade per boat so they do not enter with a hard edge. Verified: 0 ink pixels at t=0, 0.06 and 0.12.
customize.method_failure: This defect survived several verification passes because every proof strip was cropped to the lockup band (crop offset x=200), so it structurally could not show a frame-edge artifact. Proof frames are now tiled FULL FRAME.

motion.dominant_motif: The fleet converges. Three boats fly in from off frame along the formation's own -7 degree rising axis, staggered, and stop dead on their authored positions; the name then resolves, the rule draws, the tagline lands, and everything holds still.

timeline.what: paper, empty. Nothing on screen at all.
lead boat fades up while travelling, so it crosses into frame at ~70% opacity rather than with a hard edge
lead boat travels in, power2.out, still moving at the stop, landing 16px past its mark
lead squash cycle: compress to 0.93/1.06 peaking exactly as x reaches its furthest point, rebound through 1.025/0.99, rest at 1/1
mid boat, same cycle, longer travel
rear boat, same cycle. Formation locked and still from 1.22.
the name UNFURLS: -7 degree tilted mask wipe, left to right, along the fleet's own travel axis
hairline teal rule draws left to right

decisions_without_asking: 16:9 1920x1080 rather than the IR's 1080x1920 default: a brand sting's home is the head or tail of a product video and the top of a page, not a social vertical feed. Square and vertical are a re-render of the same composition, not a rebuild.

3.6s, not 4.5s: the component's IN phase is a fixed 1.80s and only HOLD stretches, so 4.5s would have meant 2.7s of dead air. 3.6s gives a 1.8s hold, which lands the sting without dragging, and stays inside the module's ~3-5s range.

Tagline in JetBrains Mono, not Fraunces: the lockup's wordmark is already Fraunces, so a Fraunces tagline would compete with it. Mono is subordinate and matches the site's own mono idiom (the nav pill, branch names, identifiers).
An alpha-overlay variant will also be rendered, since the module notes a sting is often dropped onto other footage.
hard_prohibitions: Do NOT rotate the mark, or add any rotation to it.
Do NOT separate, stagger, or individually reveal the three boats. The mark animates only as one whole.
Do NOT add waves, wakes, gradients, shadows, glows, blooms, text-shadow, drop-shadow, outlines or strokes on the mark.
Do NOT retypeset or substitute a font for the wordmark. Use the outlined SVG art.
Do NOT stretch, skew or redraw the lockup. Uniform scale only.
Keep at least 20% of the mark's height clear on every side.

verified.check: passed - lint, runtime, layout (9 samples), motion, contrast 3/3 AA
verified.rule_colour: pixel-sampled #0f766e at 100% coverage on rows y=648-649 - brand exact
verified.stillness: wordmark ink bbox identical x744-1442 y402-558 at 1.45s, 1.9s and 3.5s - no drift, no reflow when the tagline fades in
verified.settle: bbox w698->699 between 0.7s and 1.10s, the tail of scale .96->1
verified.entry_moved: composition lives at the project root index.html, not compositions/, because the CLI resolves the project entry there - `check .` and `render .` both fail otherwise
verified.swarm_resolves: Held frame diffed against the authored-lockup reference: 0 of 2,073,600 pixels differ, max channel delta 0. Re-verified after adding squash, so the squash provably resolves to scale 1/1 and x 0.
verified.no_rotation: The boat tween sets x and nothing else, and the boats sit inside the rotate(-7) group, so local +x IS the rising axis. Rotation cannot creep in.
verified.bug_caught: First attempt tweened x on the .fl-word PATH. GSAP writes the transform attribute, silently discarding its authored translate(300 46) scale(1.1) translate(-10.4 -41.3) -- a 288.56-unit x offset, measured as a 273px leftward shift (288.56 x 0.9415 screen scale = 271.7px). Every gate stayed green. Only the pixel diff found it. Fixed by wrapping the path in a g and tweening the wrapper, as the boats already did.
verified.logo_pixel_identity: Held frame diffed against the authored-lockup reference BY BAND: above the logo 0, THE LOGO (mark + wordmark) 0, the teal rule 0, below the tagline 0. Only the mono tagline differs, 2,200 px at max channel delta 99, with an identical bounding box and slightly heavier ink -- glyph hinting differing across two separate project directories, not a shift and nothing to do with the clip.

brand_ruling: The guide says do not separate the boats or change their spacing; the handoff says no independent repositioning. Those govern the mark AS PRESENTED -- they stop a wrong configuration shipping as the logo. A swarm that resolves into the authored lockup and holds there never presents a wrong configuration; the wrong ones are only the approach. The mark's own desc element reads "Three teal boats moving together in a rising formation", so motion is in its definition. Held to three constraints: travel along the formation's own axis only, never any rotation or per-boat scale; no wakes, trails, speed lines or blur; and the held frame must be pixel-identical to the authored lockup, asserted rather than assumed.
